mapper.select: select vo.order_no as orderNo, vo.voucher_id as voucherId, vo.seckill_id as seckillId, v.title as title, v.description as description, vo.redeem_code as redeemCode, vo.status as status, vo.expire_at as expireAt, vo.used_at as usedAt, vo.created_at as createdAt from voucher_order vo left join voucher v on vo.voucher_id = v.id where vo.user_uuid = #{currUserUuid} order by vo.created_at desc

select vo.order_no as orderNo, vo.voucher_id as voucherId, vo.seckill_id as seckillId, v.title as title, v.description as description, vo.redeem_code as redeemCode, vo.status as status, vo.expire_at as expireAt, vo.used_at as usedAt, vo.created_at as createdAt from voucher_order vo left join voucher v on vo.voucher_id = v.id where vo.user_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and vo.order_no = #{orderNo} limit 1
